title: Gathering of Essence - FULLY ALIVE
short_description: A vibrant gathering to reconnect, recharge, and feel fully alive. Enjoy ceremonies, ecstatic dance, forest spa, nourishing food, sound healing, and live music—surrounded by community, magic, and the beauty of the land.
description:
**☀️ Gathering of Essênce - FULLY ALIVE ☀️**\
📆 Saturday 28.3. - 13:00 - 22:00\
📍 Essência Nature Retreat (between Aljezur and Lagos )

**🪷 Contribution:** \
Early Bird until 24.3. ~ 30€ \
From 25.3. & @ the door ~ 40€

**🌀 Registration:**\
<https://fienta.com/de/gathering-of-essence-fully-alive>

🌺 Ready to blossom after this long winter? We are turning the mud into a lotus flower. Let’s connect to our inner sunshine and enjoy feeling fully alive in the middle of nature 🌳

**🌊✨ The Flow ✨🌊**

13:00 Arrival\
13:30 Opening Ceremony\
14:00 Spring Aliveness  🎉🌻\
16:00 Forest SPA & Soul-Food\
18:00 Ecstatic Dance 🔥🪩\
20:00 Sound Healing & Consensual Cuddle Puddle\
20:45 Concert Lena Younes 🎶\
21:30 Closing Ceremony

☀️ The event takes place in our beautiful Shala & outdoors

🔥 In our Forest SPA we will have a hot tub, sauna and natural pond surrounded by magical nature

🥗 We offer nourishing, organic & vegan Soul-Food for sale

❗️Please bring your yoga mat & two towels

🐞Kids are super welcome and can come for free

🌱 Please respect that Essência is a vegan, substance- and smoke-free land

🛖 Coming to this gathering supports building the wooden deck of our community yurt

📸 At the Gathering we take fotos & videos in a concious and sensitive way to create an aftermovie

⛺️ With your camper-van, caravan or tent you can stay for 10€ overnight, use our hot shower and enjoy the energy of the land the next day 

We are looking forward to celebrate our Aliveness together with you and honor the gift of being on this planet 🌍 

In Love and Joy 

🌳 The Essência Family 🤍
